title: Task plan artifact (contract 1.0.0)
description: Parsed representation of a task-plan.md artifact. Must mirror the plan recorded with the factory_set_task_plan tool.

upstreamReferences.description: Exact revisions of the approved upstream artifacts this plan is based on.

requirement.description: Revision number of the approved requirement artifact.

spec.description: Revision number of the approved spec artifact.

design.description: Revision number of the approved design artifact.

tasks.description: Ordered task records; ids must be sequential TASK-001… and match the tool-recorded plan.

metadata.description: Machine-identifiable provenance of this artifact revision.

artifactType.description: Must equal the contract's artifact type.

contractVersion.description: Semantic version of the artifact contract this document follows.

changeId.description: The factory change id this artifact belongs to.

revision.description: Revision number the extension will record for this candidate.

status.description: complete only when the document is ready for validation and review.

updatedAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of the last edit.

requiredText.description: Free-form section content; must not be empty.

nullableText.description: Section content; null only when the documented not-applicable marker was used.

id.description: Stable unique task id, sequential in execution order.

title.description: Must equal the title recorded with the task-plan tool.

scope.description: Exactly what the task changes; what it must not touch.

expectedOutput.description: The concrete deliverable of the task.

verification.description: How the task's result is verified.

dependencies.description: 'none' or comma-separated TASK ids that must finish first.

references.description: Upstream ids implemented by this task (REQ/FR/AC/DES).
